_doc: Customer exclusion by provenance for the STATVS cloud record. A session whose working folder matches a consulting.cwd_patterns entry is withheld whole. A pattern starts with ~/ (any home folder) or / ; * matches inside one path segment, ** matches across segments, and a pattern also covers everything under it. When withhold_lines_naming_paths is true, any line that names such a path is withheld too. The vector block applies only if one of your apps keeps per-tenant data: home_tenant_slug is your own tenant, tenant_id_prefix + home_tenant_slug must equal home_tenant_id, and apps, row_fields, known_other_tenants, schema_identifiers and fixture_slugs stay empty until you have such an app. Read by LIFEOS/STATVS/core/lib/provenance.ts; the shipped values withhold nothing, so add your consulting folders before you send anything to the cloud record.
